entities.summary: Murad Dadaşov is an Azerbaijani actor, producer, TV host, member of Parni iz Baku KVN team and head of M Group Production. In 2014, Dadaşov was awarded the title of Honored Artist of the Azerbaijan Republic. On 27.05.2018, he was titled People's Artist of Azerbaijan.
